answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 46435 Country: India Title: Quwat-e-Hafeza Question: Whenever I read any book whether Islamic or educational book I forgot what I have read. How to make my memory power strong? Tell me any Quranic ayat for making my memory strong. And pray for me to do good work and follow Islamic rules and regulations. I want to become a good person of Ummat-e-Muhammadia. And how to protect ourselves from sins. Answer ID: 46435 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 963/756/D=1434) You should try to avoid sins and the intention of sin. When your heart tends towards any sin, get yourself busy in any lawful job and start reading durood. Also follow sunnah and pass your life according to it. Recite Ya Qawi (يا قوي) after five times of salah putting your hand on your head. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
